usage: kathara lstart [-h] [--noterminals | --terminals] [--privileged]
                      [-d DIRECTORY] [-F] [-l] [-o [METADATA ...]]
                      [--terminal-emu TERMINAL_EMU] [--print] [--no-hosthome |
                      --hosthome] [--no-shared | --shared]
                      [--exclude DEVICE_NAME [DEVICE_NAME ...]]
                      [DEVICE_NAME ...]

Start a Kathara network scenario

positional arguments:
  DEVICE_NAME           Launches only specified devices.

options:
  -h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
  --noterminals         Start the network scenario without opening terminal
                        windows.
  --terminals           Start the network scenario opening terminal windows.
  --privileged          Start the devices in privileged mode. MUST BE ROOT FOR
                        THIS OPTION.
  -d, --directory DIRECTORY
                        Specify the folder containing the network scenario.
  -F, --force-lab       Force the network scenario to start without a lab.conf
                        or lab.dep file.
  -l, --list            Show information about running devices after the
                        network scenario has been started.
  -o, --pass [METADATA ...]
                        Apply metadata to all devices of a network scenario
                        during startup.
  --terminal-emu TERMINAL_EMU
                        Set a different terminal emulator application (Unix
                        only).
  --print, --dry-mode   Open the lab.conf file and check if it is correct (dry
                        run).
  --no-hosthome, -H     Do not mount "/hosthome" directory inside devices.
  --hosthome            Mount "/hosthome" directory inside devices.
  --no-shared, -S       Do not mount "/shared" directory inside devices.
  --shared              Mount "/shared" directory inside devices.
  --exclude DEVICE_NAME [DEVICE_NAME ...]
                        Exclude specified devices from startup.

For examples and further information visit:
https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
